class EHeightAllTheSame:
    def solve(self, testNumber, s, out):
        n = int(s[0])
        m = int(s[1])
        k = n * m
        l = int(s[2])
        r = int(s[3])
        length = r - l + 1
        mod = 998244353

        if k % 2 == 1:
            result = self.Maths.power(length, n * m, mod)
            out.write(str(result) + "\n")
            return

        ans = ((self.Maths.power(length, k, mod) + self.Maths.power(length % 2, k, mod)) * self.Maths.power(2, mod - 2, mod)) % mod
        out.write(str(ans) + "\n")

    class Maths:
        @staticmethod
        def power(x, y, p):
            res = 1
            x = x % p
            while y > 0:
                if y & 1:
                    res = (res * x) % p
                y >>= 1
                x = (x * x) % p
            return res
